description.subtitle: Malaga 2026 2027 Hummel Home Kids Shirt - Light Blue, White
description.tagline: La esencia blanquiazul de La Rosaleda
description.intro: The Hummel Málaga CF 26 27 children's shirt recovers the most collectible identity of the Andalusian club with a design of vertical stripes that connects with the history and passion of the Malaguista fans. Inspired by the colors that have accompanied the team in its most emblematic moments, this home kit combines tradition, local pride and modern style.
key_benefits: Official Málaga CF design: Home kit for the 2026 2027 season.
Classic stripes: Inspired by the club's historical identity.
Light and breathable fabric: Promotes comfort throughout the day.
Exclusive details: Finishes that reinforce the link between the club and the city of Malaga.
